metas.name: ★ 8.8 · 2026 · Punjab '95
metas.description: Triggered by the search for his missing aunt, human rights activist Jaswant Singh Khalra takes on a broken system in a courageous fight to uncover the conspiracy behind thousands of disappearances and extrajudicial killings during the nadir of Punjab’s period of insurgency.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2024 · Maidaan
metas.description: Inspired by the Indian national football team coach and manager Syed Abdul Rahim, who is regarded as the architect of Indian football.

metas.description: After learning the truth behind the brutal massacre at the Jallianwala Bagh, C Sankaran Nair, a member of the Viceroy's Council, sets out to challenge the Crown and the military general responsible.

metas.description: After the death of his father, warrior-king Sambhaji Maharaj battles Mughal forces led by Aurangzeb to keep the Maratha Empire alive.
